home.area_pharma_desc: We develop, represent and distribute pharmaceutical products for human and veterinary use, backed by international brands and a specialized technical team.

about.hero_desc: We are a company focused on providing reliable solutions, with an agile structure, a specialized team and a strategic development vision.
about.advantages_lead: At Insalcor we work to offer comprehensive solutions and excellent service at every stage of the process.
about.advantages_desc: Our strength lies in a solid structure, a highly qualified technical team and a regional network that allows us to support our clients closely and efficiently.
about.adv_regional_desc: We have consolidated operations in Uruguay, Argentina and Paraguay, allowing us to offer direct coverage and a deep understanding of each market.
about.adv_support_desc: Our team is made up of professionals with extensive experience in animal nutrition and health, committed to providing personalized technical advice.
about.adv_logistics_desc: We have a modern and agile logistics infrastructure that ensures on-time deliveries, optimizing costs and resources.
about.adv_trajectory_desc: Our track record reflects a constant commitment to excellence and the sustainable development of animal production in the region.
about.regional_p1: With operations in Uruguay, Argentina and Paraguay, Insalcor consolidates a growing regional network that integrates production, distribution and specialized technical service.
about.regional_p2: Our strategic presence in the Southern Cone reinforces our commitment to the development of the agricultural sector, promoting innovative and sustainable solutions that optimize our clients' results.
about.regional_p3: We have local teams and an integrated logistics platform that guarantee personalized attention, fast deliveries and continuous technical support, consolidating a solid structure focused on delivering value and trust in every country.
about.trust_quote: Since our beginnings, leading global companies have trusted us to market their products across Latin America's different markets.
